Synopsis

A college girl who has loved books since she was little dies in an accident and is reborn in a completely unfamiliar world. She’s now Myne, a sickly five-year-old daughter of a poor soldier. To make matters worse, this new world has an extremely low literacy rate, and books are incredibly rare and expensive—far beyond her reach.

But Myne won’t give up. If books don’t exist, she’ll just have to make them herself! Her dream is to become a librarian and live surrounded by books, no matter what it takes.

And so begins this heartwarming biblio-fantasy—the story of a young book lover’s quest to bring literature to a world without it.
